name: Burpee
research: Start = standing rest (NASM: feet hip-width, arms relaxed). End = high plank, top of the push-up. Body line: shoulder joints 0.65 m up (arm ~0.60 + fist ~0.05), ankles on the toes ~0.15 m up, shoulder-to-ankle 1.37 m -> sin a = 0.50/1.37 -> 22 deg above horizontal -> root rot X 90-22 = 68. Rx(68): shoulder mid = root + (0,-0.463,0.105); ankle = root + (0.13,0.807,-0.398). Shoulder z 0.65 -> root z 0.545, ankle z 0.147, root y 0 -> shoulders y -0.46, ankles y 0.81. Arms vertical in world = elev 68, plane 90 in torso frame (plane 82 = hands a little wider than the shoulders). Hands: the rig's hand is a grip, so the plank shows FISTS on the floor (knuckle plank, axis [-1,0,0] like a press grip), not flat palms - no wrist-extension control. Feet rot X 50 = toes on the floor, heels up. Knee pole below = kneecaps down. Hips on the straight line (Yamashita 2023: high or sagging hips = failed rep; NASM: hips must not drop). Facts and checks: research/burpee.json.
